race.comment: Brilliant pacer CYCLONE JORDY NZ (6) returns after a year on the sidelines but has been the benchmark of his generation and is unbeaten in 10 WA starts. Readied with a trial win so can pick up where he left off. Last season's WA Derby winner RUNKLE CRUNCH NZ (12) was an impressive winner by more than 10m when last seen at Gloucester Park in May. Tough draw but he strikes at 50 per cent when fresh and has won three of four attempts at the distance. LAZI DAIS (2) drew wider when midfield against open class open pacers last time. Led from this draw to win the Westbred Classic when fresh prior so can give a big sight. SOHO SHAKEDOWN (3) is another drawn well and has recorded two wins and a second in three starts this time in. Has won four of five tries here so is hard to knock.
